title: Count Substrings Containing All Three Characters
statement:
Given a string S consisting only of the characters 'a', 'b', and 'c', count the number of substrings that contain at least one occurrence of each of 'a', 'b', and 'c'.

Use the two-pointer (sliding window) technique for an O(N) solution: once a valid window [l, r] is found, all extensions of the right end (r, r+1, ..., N-1) are also valid, contributing N-r substrings.
inputFormat: A single line containing the string S.
outputFormat: A single integer: the count of substrings containing at least one 'a', one 'b', and one 'c'.
